================================================================================
attribute splat
================================================================================

locals {
  x = aws_instance.web.*.id
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (expression
            (expression
              (variable_expr
                (identifier)))
            (get_attr
              name: (identifier)))
          (splat
            (attr_splat
              (get_attr
                name: (identifier)))))))))

locals {

        value: (expression
          (expression
            (expression
              (variable_expr
                (identifier)))
            (get_attr
              name: (identifier)))
          (splat
